brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut: they keep 8.5% profit vs peers' 4.8% — there's cushion to share

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 10–15% price reduction on caps and bottles
priceAsk.target: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm caps (currently trading at ₹0.85–0.95/pc in the open market)
priceAsk.basis: They keep 8.5% of every sale as profit, nearly double the 4.8% other packaging firms keep. The open-market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. Their fat margin means they can afford to move toward that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 45 days to 30 days in exchange for a share of the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Shifting to 30 days frees up ₹2.15 L of our cash; going to 15 days would free another ₹1.08 L on top

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is healthy: no debt (0.00x), strong interest cover (75.84x), safe distress score (6.18), and keeps a fat 8.5% profit. But their cash is tied up for 124 days (vs 114 for peers), and we're tiny — just 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue. They won't bend on price for our ₹26.17 L alone, so we need to bring volume (bundle more SKUs or commit longer) or dangle a credible second source. One risk flag: EPF payment delays, so watch their labour practices. We can push hard on price because their profit cushion is real, but tighten payment terms carefully — their cash cycle is already stretched ten days longer than similar firms.

evidence.point: They keep nearly double the profit of similar packaging firms
Market asking price for 28 mm caps shows room to move lower at volume
We are a very small customer to them
Moving to 30-day payment frees up cash for us
Their cash is stuck longer than peers
Zero debt and very strong interest cover

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100) — a strong, proven second source

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers and pharma packaging — robust and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited (India-East)
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): manufacturer in the East, medium confidence — potential upstream resin or preform source

risks: EPF payment delays flagged in their filings — check labour-law compliance and any reputational issues before deepening the relationship
Our ₹26.17 L is only 0.15% of their sales, so on our own we have almost no pull — bundle more volume, commit multi-year, or bring a credible alternate to the table
Their cash cycle is 124 days (10 days longer than peers), so pushing payment terms tighter than 30 days may squeeze them more than the numbers suggest

Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads from public research — none are qualified or priced yet, so treat them as long-term diversification plays, not immediate substitutes
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about bringing our cap and bottle prices in line with the market — you're keeping 8.5% profit, nearly double your peers at 4.8%, so there's room to share some of that with us.
